chapter.heading: Psalm 41
O LORD, Be Gracious to Me
To the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
the LORD
protects him,
and keeps him alive; he is called blessed in the land; you do not give him up to the will of his enemies.

The LORD
sustains him,
on his sickbed; in his illness you restore him to full health.(2)

As for
me, I,
said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me,(3) for I have sinned against you!”

My enemies
say of,
me in malice, “When will he die, and his name perish?”

And when
one comes,
to see me, he utters empty words, while his heart gathers iniquity; when he goes out, he tells it abroad.

All who
hate me,
whisper together about me; they imagine the worst for me.(4)

They say,
“A deadly,
thing is poured out(5) on him; he will not rise again from where he lies.”

Even my
close friend,
in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has lifted his heel against me.

But you,
O LORD,,
be gracious to me, and raise me up, that I may repay them!

By this
I know,
that you delight in me: my enemy will not shout in triumph over me.

But you
have upheld,
me because of my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

Blessed be
the LORD,,
the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen. Footnotes (1) 41:1 Or *weak* (2) 41:3 Hebrew *you turn all his bed* (3) 41:4 Hebrew *my soul* (4) 41:7 Or *they devise evil against me* (5) 41:8 Or *has fastened* (ESV)
